en: Vintage sepia photograph of a grand neoclassical–baroque theatre building seen from the front-left corner, with ornate facades, arched windows, sculptures, and statues on the roof. A curved driveway and landscaped area lead up to the entrance. Decorative street lamps stand in the foreground. At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the building as the national theatre.
